templates.why_chosen: High-confidence nested-stack exemplar on its left half: an outer frame nests Generator, Leakage Model and Executor regions that each nest a Test Case or trace box, four levels deep, at 14 components and 10 flows.
templates.what_to_learn: Nest a shared Test Case object one level inside the Generator region that produced it so both consumers can be drawn pulling from the same box; the record's weakness warns that leaving two halves adjacent without a connecting arrow can hide how they relate, so add one even when space is tight.

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from block-floorplan by the note-writer: this is a software test-generation pipeline feeding a paired-trace equality/inequality comparison that concludes in a Violation Found ellipse; there is no hardware vocabulary, chip boundary, or physical placement anywhere.
templates.what_to_learn: Treat this as a generator/model/executor pipeline instead: fork one test case into a Leakage Model and an Executor that each produce a trace, then join the traces with a visual == / != gate feeding an AND into a bold Violation Found result; draw the missing arrow linking the two halves.
